messages:
alex: Heads-up: during the midnight change window the dedicated embeddings pool saw throughput drop ~20% after canary to v4.1.0 started at 00:02 UTC.
gina: saw it too. Throughput down, tail latency up. Any deploybot signals?
deploybot: rollout to v4.1.0 started 00:02 (canary 5%) region=use1.
noah: deploybot posted an auto-detect: "throughput regression: p99 > threshold for 3m" but auto-revert is disabled for embeddings routes in this window.
trent: can we target only the dedicated pool and leave hosted alone? We have active customer contracts that could be impacted if we flip the whole route.
eva: yes, we can limit traffic unshift to the dedicated pool via `rictl route update --service embeddings --scope dedicated --percent-from 5 --percent-to 0 --duration 180s`
alex: prefer staged unwind: 5% -> 0% over 3m, then hold 10m for verification. If still bad, pin previous (v4.0.7) for dedicated and open rollback PR.
gina: agreed. Also collect `kernel_flag` and `allocstats` from nodes. Noah, can you kick a trace?
noah: running quick trace: `ssh node-emb-01 -- sudo journalctl -u embeddingd -n 200 | grep -i alloc` -> seeing bursts around 00:06 UTC. Dumping to gist: https://logs.internal/g/emb-7315
pm-lee: heads-up I'll prep a one-paragraph customer note in case we pin. Keep messaging tight.
deploybot: canary now at 3% per rollout plan.
eva: command issued to shift canary on dedicated -> response ok: shifting 5->0 over 180s.
(90s)
trent: holding on metrics... p99 trending down as traffic sheds. CPU on emb pool nodes dropping.
gina: after 4m at 0% on dedicated error/throughput back to baseline. Hosted routes unchanged.
noah: traces indicate allocator hot-loop triggered by a mempattern in v4.1.0; attaching sample: `ALLOC 00:06:12 size=8192 pattern=0x7f... path=quant_kernel_v3`
alex: sounds like quant kernel path causing mem churn. Plan: pin v4.0.7 for dedicated, keep hosted at v4.1.0 canary halted. Open rollback PR for infra manifests then schedule targeted patch.
gina: I'll run the pin: `rictl pin version --service embeddings --version v4.0.7 --scope dedicated --note "staged unwind 00:08 UTC"` -> ok.
pm-lee: drafting customer note: "We observed degraded throughput on dedicated embeddings during our maintenance window; traffic has been shifted to a stable version and we are investigating. No data exposure."
eva: created rollback PR: https://git.internal/infra/pull/4499 (adds revert for dedicated canary)
deploybot: canary for dedicated drained to 0%.
trent: recommend we keep dedicated pinned for 12h and run a compatibility test harness against v4.1.0 with larger alloc sizes.
oah: starting nightly stress job now, results in ~2h but I'll post early flags.
alex: owners: noah=trace/RCA, gina=pin & ops note, eva=rollback PR, pm-lee=customer comms. If anything regresses we escalate to full revert.
pm-lee: will send customer blurb after 30m verification.
gina: logging ticket to SRE rotation for tomorrow morning to monitor.
alex: thanks all. :white_check_mark:
(2h later)
oah: early RCA draft: quant_kernel_v3 alloc pattern incompatible with jemalloc tuning used on dedicated nodes; leads to fragmentation and throughput drop under batched workloads. Draft PM in #postmortems.
pm-lee: customer note posted at 02:45 UTC.
eva: merged rollback PR for infra canaries.
deploybot: manifests updated; dedicated canary restored to v4.0.7.
trent: closing thread for immediate action items. Follow-ups in postmortem + patch ticket."
